methods.name: searchCatalog
methods.description:
Searches Data Catalog for multiple resources like entries, tags that match a query.

Implemented in Google\Cloud\DataCatalog\V1\Gapic\DataCatalogGapicClient

params.name: scope
params.description: Required. The scope of this search request. A scope that has empty include_org_ids, include_project_ids AND false include_gcp_public_datasets is considered invalid. Data Catalog will return an error in such a case.

params.name: query
params.description:
Required. The query string in search query syntax. The query must be non-empty.

Query strings can be simple as "x" or more qualified as:

  • name:x
  • column:x
  • description:y

Note: Query tokens need to have a minimum of 3 characters for substring matching to work correctly. See Data Catalog Search Syntax for more information.
